mainFeatures.title: Main Features
mainFeatures.subtitle: Here's a glimpse at the main features our script offers

list.advancedPaywall: Buy and sell content in various formats, including subscriptions or pay-per-view (PPV) content, using paid or free to follow profiles.
list.advancedPosting: Comprehensive posting tools, such as draft posts, scheduled posts, expiring posts, pay-per-view posts, blurred previews for posts and more.
list.liveMessenger: Keep your audience engaged through our live messenger module, enabling you to offer PPV content and more.
list.mobileReady: Experience your favorite content on any screen or device, thanks to our cross-compatible and mobile-first design.
list.themes: Enjoy your favourite content on either dark & light mode. You can also generate custom themes on the fly.
list.localization: Easily localize your site with multiple languages and right-to-left (RTL) compatibility, providing a seamless experience for users worldwide.
list.bookmarks: Stay organized by bookmarking posts and managing user lists, ensuring easy access to your favorite content and creators.
list.reporting: Enhance community safety by enabling users to report unsuitable content and conduct, facilitating prompt and efficient moderation.
list.liveStreaming: Stay engaged with your audience using live streaming via RMTP technology. OBS or alternative software is required.
